content.text: This is the mock provider. It writes one probe file so the tool loop can be verified, then stops.

Added a minimal header bar at the top with the app name and today's date. Updated src/App.tsx to include a header section above the main content. The header displays "Invoice Tracker" and the current date formatted via toLocaleDateString(). Styling uses existing Tailwind utilities for a clean look. No other files needed changes. The preview should now show the header bar at the top of the page.

Added a minimal header bar at the top of the app displaying the app name "Invoice Tracker" and today's date. The header uses Tailwind utilities for a clean, subtle look (white text with 5% opacity, centered, with a slight background). The date updates dynamically via `new Date().toLocaleDateString()`.

The header sits above the existing main content in `src/App.tsx`. No other files were needed. In the preview you should see the header bar at the very top of the page, followed by the centered "Ready to build" section.
